chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbbād ibn Ṣuhayb, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام.
Concerning a man whom the Imam had made stand for liʿān.
So he gave two testimonies, then refrained and declared himself to be lying before he completed the liʿān.
He عليه السلام said: “He is to be lashed with the hadd of the slanderer, and separation is not effected between him and his wife.”

key_terms.أَكْذَبَ نَفْسَهُ: he declared himself to be false in his claim
key_terms.اللِّعَانِ: the mutual imprecation procedure between spouses in a legal accusation of adultery
key_terms.امْرَأَتِهِ: his wife, in relation to the marital ruling under discussion
key_terms.حَدَّ الْقَاذِفِ: the fixed punishment of one who falsely accuses another of illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.شَهَادَتَيْنِ: two formal testimonies uttered as part of the liʿān process
key_terms.نَكَلَ: he recoiled or refrained from continuing the legal procedure
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is to be flogged as a prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man retracts during liʿān before completing it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liʿān when a husband begins the procedure but retracts before completing it. In that case, he is punished with the hadd of qadhf, and no separation takes place between him and his wife because the liʿān was not completed.
